item.title: Slow start sinks Eaton in Senior Night loss to Valley View
item.description: EATON — A fast start by Valley View proved too much for Eaton to overcome in a Southwestern Buckeye League Buckeye Division girls basketball game on Thursday, Feb. 12. The post Slow start sinks Eaton in Senior Night loss to Valley View appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Winter Guard performs at first competition of year
item.description: On Saturday January 31, the Eaton Winterguard which is made up of 8th through 12th graders competed at their first competition of the season. The team consists of 23 students and performs in the Mid Eastern Performance Association. This year, their show is titled “From seeds to Strength”. The team is led by Captain Sydney Atkinson, a junior at Miami Valley CTC. item.title: Union income tax vital for police & fire
item.description: UNION — Voters in Union will be deciding on a proposed permanent increase of 1 percent to the municipal income tax rate, which would be effective January 1, 2027. The post Union income tax vital for police & fire appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.description: COLUMBUS — High school seniors across Ohio planning careers in public service are encouraged to apply for the Ohio Counties 2026 Scholarship, a $2,000 award sponsored by the County Commissioners Association of Ohio Research and Educational Foundation. item.description: CLAYTON — City council at its February 5 meeting appointed LeeAnne Bustos to fill a council vacancy for Ward 1. The post Clayton fills council vacancy appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Storage barn for Boy Scouts planned
item.description: BROOKVILE — The park board voted to allow the construction of a storage barn near the BMX building in Golden Gate Park so Scout Pack 47 can store the Christmas displays the Scouts erect for the annual Christmas event held in the park. The post Storage barn for Boy Scouts planned appeared first on The Register Herald.
